Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework

Record Class ChatComponentSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework.ChatComponentSnapshot
Record Components:
json - Native component-codec JSON, retained verbatim.
public record ChatComponentSnapshot(String json) extends Record
Frozen native chat-component JSON with shared literal-text and effective-click interpretation.

Literal strings, component arrays and extra children are supported, including inherited click events. Translation keys, selectors, scores, keybinds and hover contents are not rendered as literal main-message text.

    • clickActions

      public List<ChatComponentSnapshot.ClickAction> clickActions()
      Decodes contiguous literal runs and their effective click actions.

      Adjacent literal runs with the same action and payload are combined. Non-clickable text and opaque non-literal content prevent accidental association across unrelated portions of a message.

      Returns:
      Immutable literal click actions; textless style nodes may carry an empty text run.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - When JSON or supported component structure cannot be decoded.
